name: Fuel cycle strip (DEAD CODE)
gap: Not rebuilt, and the reason is now written into fuel.html's own header comment: the strip was dead code in v6, a cycle is a Stack question, and Fuel is where a gated feature would announce itself to people who have never turned it on.

where: fuel.html - build-recipe sheet, ingGrams / ingMacros / ingHits

name: Barcode product found — portion, meal, log
Barcode not found — manual label entry
where: fuel.html - scan-manual carries the code, manualAdd keeps it

name: AI meal-item normalisation
gap: Needs a vision model to normalise into items. The local half is built and honest: a real file input, the plate as removable items, the oil question, and a caption saying the items are a worked example and not what is in the picture. Nothing is faked.

name: Pantry depletion on logging + expiry heuristics
gap: Best-price and last-price helpers are still absent, and they belong on shopping.html, which this package does not own: prices live in lk_budgetData and lk_myStores and nothing in Fuel writes either. Expiry is done as far as it honestly can be - no pantry row carries a date on the packet, so 'worth using' is worked out from when it went in against your own restock interval, and says so.

name: Fuel micro-helpers (slots, favourites, training day, water goal)
Fuel sub-tab navigation (Log / Meals toggle + pill row)
Fuel Profile — body weight input + unit toggle
Fuel Profile — height input (ft/in or cm)
Fuel Profile — Auto vs Custom macros
Adaptive TDEE application on tab mount
Refeed day prompt and active banner
Meal plan — generate new plan form
gap: The generator is still a picker over an eight-row food table, which is a property of the seed rather than of the feature: a three-meal week can land short, and the preview says by how much and why. Budget is named where the week is built and explicitly not costed into it, because the food table carries no prices and a costed plan would be a figure this app made up.

name: Meal plan — JSON repair and shopping list rebuild
gap: Nothing local generates JSON, so there is nothing to repair. The shopping-list half it existed to protect is built and does not need a model: plan and recipe ingredients are parsed into quantity, unit and name and merged into existing rows. A repair step only becomes real when a model is answering.

name: My Store (saved foods)
where: fuel.html - yourFoodsSection and the store rows in searchable()

name: USDA API key setup
gap: Needs the proxy that holds the credentials: USDA wants an API key and FatSecret an OAuth client, and a key shipped inside a page is a key given away. Deliberately NO key field on the screen - there is nothing here that could send a request with it, and the storage key belongs to the shipped app rather than to this package. The search sheet names all three sources and says plainly that nothing it shows came off the network; the reason is recorded in the source above the search sheet.

name: RCard: Add to shop (ingredients → shopping list)
Coach recipes (read-only, from a coach)
gap: The read half is built: lk_coachRecipes is read, listed beside your own, marked 'from your coach' and read-only. Nothing writes it - a coach's recipes travel over the same account sync as their plan - and the recipes sheet says exactly that rather than showing an empty section.

name: MealPlannerTab — dead duplicate meal planner
gap: Not carried over, and the reason is now written into fuel.html's header comment: the v6 component had no route and no control, so there is one meal planner, in Fuel's Plan sheet, and nothing a person could reach is lost.
